_review: Part b of 35-40. Entry is the Booty Bay dock (exit of 35-40a). The first step accepts Goblin Sponsorship from Baron Revilgaz (1183) before the boat, since he is only in Booty Bay.
Stale: 35-40a ends with the same Booty Bay to Ratchet boat as a TRAVEL step. Both the 35-40a last step and this route's boat step describe one crossing; keep one of them when stitching.

Pack state: 45 of the 163 pack quests were already turned in by horde_horde_30-35 (see the curated reasons), so they are not repeated. 5741 (Sceptre of Light) is in this pack and was turned in by 30-35, so the handoff note saying it is in neither pack is stale.

Handoffs: 692 (needs 687) and 1108 (needs 1106) are not in this pack. 687 needs 653 or 688, both behind the 652 elite (revisit 42 in 40-45a), so 692 is dropped. 1108 is a Badlands turn-in with 1106, which is also dropped; 40-45a should pick up the Martek chain if it passes the Badlands.

1183 is outside this pack (it was dropped in 30-35 and 35-40a). It is routed here as a W_NOT_IN_PACK quest so that 1186, 1187 and the Razzeric booster can continue. 1188 and 1189 (Tanaris, Gadgetzan) are dropped as a second Shimmering loop for 820 XP each.
Revisit chains 193, 518, 519, 628, 640, 643, 644, 652, 673, 679 and 680 are not in this pack; they are routed as optional-elite steps in 35-40a. 645, 646, 670 and 688 are dropped there as well.

Elite decisions: 1488, 96222, 4961 and 1955 are optional-elite with revisitAt (40, 42, 40, 40). 1380, 1381, 1383, 2283 and 7068 are unroutable (blocked prerequisites, Eastern Kingdoms, or instanced Maraudon); the reasons are in dropped[].

Reputation: the Gelkis and Magram line (1367 to 1375, 1380 and 1381, plus the Forever clan quests 92743 to 93196) is dropped as reputation-gated, as 30-35 dropped it. This is the largest XP loss in the pack (about 25k).

Trainer gaps: no Stonard visit (shaman, warlock, hunter, warrior, druid-free), so Stonard is not reachable on this path. Warlock and rogue have no trainer at 38; their next visit is Orgrimmar at 40 (gap 3, within the limit). Druid, shaman, priest, paladin are covered at Thunder Bluff.

Class quests: warlock Orb of Orahil (1799, 4962, 4961, 4976) and mage chains (1947, 1953, 1949, 1954, 1955) run through Tabetha and Menara. Warlock Felsteed (3631, 4490) is dropped because it starts in Orgrimmar and turns in at Ratchet. Shaman 79364 is kept as a talk quest. Class XP is not counted by the validator.

Validator question: quest 4964 (Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil) has preQuestGroup [-4962, 4976] in the DB. The negative id is read literally, so the validator reports E_PREREQ for -4962. Dropped here; check whether negative preQuestGroup ids are a convention the validator should accept.

Hearth: the bind moves from Ratchet to Shadowprey (Sikewa) in the middle of Desolace, so the Desolace north loop (Ethel Rethor, Thunder Axe) can return by hearth. After that the route walks from Dustwallow back to Ratchet.
Trainers: Thunder Bluff at level 38 (druid, hunter, mage, paladin, priest, shaman, warrior). Orgrimmar at 40 is the last stop before the zeppelin to Grom'gol.

Exit: the Orgrimmar zeppelin to Grom'gol Base Camp (Stranglethorn, Nez'raz platform at 31.4, 29.9). This is the entry for 40-45a in Stranglethorn. The 40-45a route is not written yet, so W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED is expected.

XP: quest XP from main and optional quests is far below the 242,600 budget for 37 to 40 (the pack has about 205k open XP in total, but most is in dungeons, reputation, professions, class-only chains, elites and Eastern Kingdoms zones). Expected to read as W_XP_RANGE; not padded with dungeon or reputation content, per the brief.

Flights used: Thalon (Shadowprey), Nyse (Freewind Post), Shardi (Brackenwall) and Bragok (Ratchet) are discovered; Gadgetzan (Tanaris) is not, and it is not on this route. Flight connectivity between these masters is assumed; walk if a flight is not in game.
